# Spring-NWVMC (`0.1.0`) — Documentation Index for LLMs & AI Agents

> Enterprise declarative REST, GraphQL, persistence, RBAC/ABAC security, resilience, and observability starter for **Java 21 LTS** and **Spring Boot 3.x** (`io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` on Maven Central; optional JitPack mirror: `com.github.NatswarChuan:Spring-NWVMC:v0.1.0`).

## Quick Adoption Kit Links

- [AI-Agent Adoption Kit README](../ai-agent-kit/README.md): English onboarding guide, compatibility matrix for every AI coding tool and LLM, plus zero-clone 1-command installers (`install.ps1` / `install.sh`).
- [INTRO](../ai-agent-kit/INTRO.md): Architecture, Maven Central / JitPack setup, 2-Directory Contract, 9 composable API interfaces.
- [RULES](../ai-agent-kit/RULES.md): Strict anti-hallucination guardrails & verified runtime pitfalls.
- [SKILL](../ai-agent-kit/SKILL.md): Step-by-step adoption workflows & troubleshooting matrix.
- [CHECKLIST](../ai-agent-kit/CHECKLIST.md): 6-phase Pre-Flight, Design, Security Lockdown & Verification checklist.
- [60 Annotations & 133 Attributes Reference](../ai-agent-kit/references/01-annotations-exact-matrix.md): 1:1 verified annotation specification.
- [40 Auto-Endpoints & 13 Query Operators](../ai-agent-kit/references/02-endpoints-and-query-dsl.md): Complete route map & verified `curl` examples.
- [YAML Properties & Profiles](../ai-agent-kit/references/03-yaml-properties-and-profiles.md): Exact `app.framework.*` properties & `dev`/`prod` profiles.
- [Verified Cookbook Patterns](../ai-agent-kit/references/04-cookbook-verified-patterns.md): Copy-paste Java, YAML, `@MultiTenant`, DB-RBAC, Multi-Datasource, and `MockMvc` recipes.
- [Exact Non-Annotation Class & SPI Imports](../ai-agent-kit/references/05-imports-and-spi-contracts.md): Verified imports & signatures for all non-annotation classes, constants, DTOs, helpers, and SPIs.
- [SDD & TDD Playbook](../ai-agent-kit/references/06-sdd-and-tdd-playbook.md): Spec-Driven (`specs/<feature>/{spec,plan,tasks}.md`) & Test-Driven (`Red → Green → Refactor`, 4-Tier Test Pyramid) playbook with starter templates in [`../ai-agent-kit/templates/`](../ai-agent-kit/templates/).
